name: Arisu Yurika
source:
A cheerful, energetic girl. She has a quick wit and conducts herself well. A fairy-tale-like love will bloom between her and the men she meets in the Looking-Glass Country.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/10/17/taisho-alice-introduction/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
